fixture_home_source_pair.name: fixture_home_source_pair
fixture_home_source_pair.value: ("fixtures"."home_source_id" IS NULL AND "fixtures"."home_source_outcome" IS NULL) OR ("fixtures"."home_source_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fixtures"."home_source_outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "fixtures"."home_source_outcome" IN ('winner', 'loser'))

fixture_away_source_pair.name: fixture_away_source_pair
fixture_away_source_pair.value: ("fixtures"."away_source_id" IS NULL AND "fixtures"."away_source_outcome" IS NULL) OR ("fixtures"."away_source_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fixtures"."away_source_outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "fixtures"."away_source_outcome" IN ('winner', 'loser'))

registrations_staff_no_ack.name: registrations_staff_no_ack
registrations_staff_no_ack.value: "registrations"."source" <> 'staff' OR ("registrations"."rules_version" IS NULL AND "registrations"."eligibility_acknowledged" IS NULL AND "registrations"."answers" = '{}'::jsonb)

result_approval_actor_pair.name: result_approval_actor_pair
result_approval_actor_pair.value: ("result_revisions"."approved_at" IS NULL AND "result_revisions"."approved_by" IS NULL) OR ("result_revisions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "result_revisions"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL)

staff_scoped_role_unique.name: staff_scoped_role_unique
staff_scoped_role_unique.where: "staff_roles"."edition_slug" IS NOT NULL AND "staff_roles"."revoked_at" IS NULL
